title: Silent No More
tagline: A secure portal for women to store and share harassment evidence safely with law enforcement.
description:
We empower victims to upload screenshots, chats, voice notes, and proof of abuse.
All evidence is secured using IPFS decentralized storage and Filecoin blockchain.
With wallet-based login, victims alone control and manage their own evidence.
Our consent-driven system lets victims decide what to share and when to share.
Police get restricted access codes, viewing only the evidence victims authorize.
how_its_made:
Let me blow your mind with what we built. This isn't your typical web app - this is next-generation victim advocacy powered by cutting-edge blockchain and AI.

Starting with the foundation - Next.js and React create a lightning-fast, intuitive interface. Dynamic Labs integration means users connect instantly with MetaMask or any Ethereum wallet. No passwords, no email verification - just pure cryptographic authentication that's impossible to fake.

Our backend is Node.js powerhouse with Express, but here's the kicker - your evidence never actually lives on our servers. We use a revolutionary dual-storage system: instant upload to IPFS via Pinata, then automatic migration to Filecoin for permanent, decentralized storage. It's like having a digital vault that even we can't break into.

Now for the game-changer - Hedera Mirror Node integration with machine learning that actually saves lives. Our AI monitors real-time platform data, analyzing conversation patterns, emotional distress indicators, and escalation signals. When someone's in danger, our ML algorithms detect it instantly and prioritize their case automatically.

The AI doesn't just store data - it learns from anonymized patterns to predict when victims need immediate intervention, suggests legal resources, and even identifies abuse escalation before it happens. We're literally using artificial intelligence to prevent violence.
